questions.question: At a great sacrifice to their god Dagon, what did the Philistine lords say their god had done?

answers.text: Sent rain down on their fields

questions.question: In a packed Philistine temple, Samson prayed for strength for one vengeful blow. What did he want that blow to do?

answers.text: Break him free of his shackles
Win him a way back home

questions.question: When Samson pushed with all his might against the two central pillars of the Philistine temple, what happened to the temple?

answers.text: It fell on the lords and all the people
Only the roof came crashing down

questions.question: Samson killed fewer people in his death than he had killed during his life. True or false?
